questions.q: Why does the Regional Manager's request need a new Gold table instead of just reading gold.daily_sales_summary?
options: gold.daily_sales_summary is only refreshed once a month
silver.sales_clean doesn't contain a category column
gold.daily_sales_summary only groups by store_id and sale_date, so it can't show which categories are driving a store's numbers
gold.daily_sales_summary doesn't include total_sales
questions.explain: The existing table answers "how did each store do" but was never grouped by category, so it can't show a category-level breakdown.

questions.q: What three columns does the aggregation for gold.category_breakdown GROUP BY?
options: transaction_id, store_id, category
store_id, category, sale_date
product_id, unit_price, quantity
store_id, sale_timestamp, source_file
questions.explain: The table is built one row per store, per category, per day, so the GROUP BY is on store_id, category, and sale_date.

questions.q: Which source table does gold.category_breakdown get built from?
options: silver.sales_clean
bronze.sales_raw
gold.daily_sales_summary
meta.last_ingested_date
questions.explain: The Gold aggregation reads from the clean, upserted silver.sales_clean table, not raw Bronze or the other Gold table.

questions.q: Why is it safe for gold.category_breakdown to be written with a plain `mode("overwrite")` every run, instead of its own MERGE INTO?
options: Because gold.category_breakdown has no sale_date column, so there's nothing to upsert against
Because Delta Lake tables cannot be merged into, only overwritten
Because Silver is now kept correct and comparatively small by the incremental MERGE, so recomputing a group-by over all of it every run is cheap and simple
Because the Regional Manager asked for the table to be rebuilt from scratch
questions.explain: The Silver-layer redesign makes a full recompute of Gold cheap and correct; adding incremental merge logic at the Gold layer would only add complexity with no real benefit.

questions.q: In the aggregation, what does total_sales represent, and what does total_quantity represent?
options: Both are counts of distinct transaction_id values
total_sales is the sum of quantity; total_quantity is the sum of total_amount
total_sales is a row count; total_quantity is the sum of unit_price
total_sales is the sum of total_amount; total_quantity is the sum of quantity
questions.explain: The aggregation sums total_amount into total_sales and sums quantity into total_quantity, matching the fixed schema for this table.
